notes: Source TTM ROCE repeated TTM ROE; showing FY26 ROCE instead.

debt_to_assets.label: Debt / assets
debt_to_assets.what: Share of assets funded by borrowings.

rota.label: Return on tangible assets
rota.what: Net profit per ₹100 of tangible assets.

roa.label: ROA
roa.what: Net profit per ₹100 of total assets.

quick_ratio.label: Quick ratio
quick_ratio.read: Above 1 means bills can be paid without selling stock.

cash_conversion_cycle.label: Cash conversion cycle
cash_conversion_cycle.what: Days between paying for inputs and collecting from customers.
cash_conversion_cycle.read: Negative means suppliers fund the business.
cash_conversion_cycle.formula: Inventory days + debtor days − payable days

dividend_payout.label: Dividend payout
dividend_payout.what: Share of profit paid out as dividends.

debt_to_fcf.label: Debt / free cash flow
debt_to_fcf.what: Years of free cash flow needed to repay all debt.

lt_debt_to_equity.label: Long-term debt / equity
lt_debt_to_equity.read: Long-term debt is safer than short-term rollovers.

financial_leverage.label: Financial leverage
financial_leverage.read: Higher means the balance sheet leans more on liabilities.

asset_turnover.label: Asset turnover
asset_turnover.read: Higher means assets are worked harder.

roce.label: ROCE
roce.what: Operating profit per ₹100 of all capital, equity plus debt.
roce.read: Should comfortably beat the cost of borrowing; above 15% is good.

interest_coverage.label: Interest coverage
interest_coverage.what: How many times operating profit covers interest.
interest_coverage.read: Above 3× is comfortable; below 1.5× is strain.

inventory_days.label: Inventory days
inventory_days.what: Days of sales held as stock.
inventory_days.read: Rising days can signal slowing demand.

retention_ratio.label: Retention ratio
retention_ratio.what: Share of profit kept in the business.
retention_ratio.read: High retention needs high returns on capital to create value.

current_ratio.label: Current ratio
current_ratio.read: Above 1 is comfortable; fuel and FMCG retailers often run below 1 because customers pay instantly.

net_margin.label: Net margin
net_margin.read: Thin margins magnify the effect of input-cost swings.

effective_tax_rate.label: Effective tax rate
effective_tax_rate.what: Tax actually charged as a share of pre-tax profit.
effective_tax_rate.read: India's corporate rate is about 25%; big gaps deserve a look.

payable_days.label: Payable days
payable_days.what: Days the company takes to pay suppliers.
payable_days.read: Higher keeps cash longer but can strain suppliers.

roe.label: ROE
roe.what: Profit earned per ₹100 of shareholders' money.
roe.read: Above 15% is generally strong. Check it isn't driven by heavy debt.

pretax_margin.label: Pre-tax margin
pretax_margin.what: Profit before tax per ₹100 of sales.

debt_to_equity.label: Debt / equity
debt_to_equity.read: Below 0.5 is conservative; above 1 is heavily borrowed (banks excepted).

ebitda_margin.label: EBITDA margin
ebitda_margin.what: Profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation per ₹100 of sales.

gross_margin.label: Gross margin
gross_margin.what: Revenue left after the direct cost of goods.
gross_margin.read: Shows pricing power over raw materials.

ebit_margin.label: EBIT margin
ebit_margin.what: Profit before interest and tax per ₹100 of sales.

operating_margin.label: Operating margin
operating_margin.read: Compare within the industry; single digits are normal for refiners and retailers.

revenue_cagr_3y.label: 3Y sales CAGR
revenue_cagr_3y.what: Average yearly sales growth over 3 years.
revenue_cagr_3y.read: Compare with inflation plus GDP (~10–11% nominal).

revenue_cagr_5y.label: 5Y sales CAGR
revenue_cagr_5y.what: Average yearly sales growth over 5 years.
revenue_cagr_5y.read: Above ~10–11% nominal is healthy for a mature business.

profit_cagr_3y.label: 3Y profit CAGR
profit_cagr_3y.what: Average yearly net profit growth over 3 years.
profit_cagr_3y.read: Compare with sales growth to see if margins are expanding.

profit_cagr_5y.label: 5Y profit CAGR
profit_cagr_5y.what: Average yearly net profit growth over 5 years.
profit_cagr_5y.read: Compare with sales growth to see if margins are expanding.

eps_cagr_5y.label: 5Y EPS CAGR
eps_cagr_5y.what: Average yearly growth in earnings per share over 5 years.
eps_cagr_5y.read: Captures dilution that profit growth hides.

ebitda_cagr_5y.label: 5Y EBITDA CAGR
ebitda_cagr_5y.what: Average yearly growth in EBITDA over 5 years.
ebitda_cagr_5y.read: Operating earnings growth before capital structure effects.

book_value_cagr_5y.label: 5Y book value CAGR
book_value_cagr_5y.what: Average yearly growth in net worth over 5 years.
book_value_cagr_5y.read: Steady compounding of equity is a quality signal.

cfo_cagr_3y.label: 3Y operating cash CAGR
cfo_cagr_3y.what: Average yearly growth in operating cash flow over 3 years.
cfo_cagr_3y.read: Cash growth should track profit growth.

opm.label: Operating margin (statements)
opm.what: Operating profit ÷ sales from the latest annual P&L.
opm.read: Compare with peers in the same industry.

npm.label: Net margin (statements)
npm.what: Net profit ÷ sales from the latest annual P&L.
npm.read: Thin margins leave little room for cost shocks.

liabilities_to_assets.label: Liabilities / assets
liabilities_to_assets.what: Share of assets funded by liabilities.

sales_growth_latest.label: Sales growth (latest year)
sales_growth_latest.what: Sales growth in the latest full year.
sales_growth_latest.read: One year can be noisy; read with the CAGR.
sales_growth_latest.formula: Sales this year ÷ sales last year − 1

profit_growth_latest.label: Profit growth (latest year)
profit_growth_latest.what: Net profit growth in the latest full year.
profit_growth_latest.read: One year can be noisy; read with the CAGR.
profit_growth_latest.formula: PAT this year ÷ PAT last year − 1

market_cap.label: Market cap
market_cap.what: The value of all the company's shares at today's price.

dividend_yield.label: Dividend yield
dividend_yield.what: Dividends paid in the last 12 months ÷ today's price.
dividend_yield.read: A high yield can come from a falling price, so check the payout is sustainable.

cfo_to_pat.label: Cash conversion (CFO/PAT)
cfo_to_pat.read: 100% or more means profit turned into cash. Below 70% for years is a warning.

fcf_to_pat.label: FCF / PAT
fcf_to_pat.read: Shows how much profit is left after reinvestment.

sales_cagr.label: Sales CAGR
sales_cagr.what: Average yearly sales growth (5 years where available).
sales_cagr.read: Above ~10–11% nominal is healthy for a mature business.

profit_cagr.label: Profit CAGR
profit_cagr.what: Average yearly net profit growth (5 years where available).
profit_cagr.read: Should keep pace with sales growth; slower means margins are shrinking.

ev_ebitda.label: EV/EBITDA
ev_ebitda.what: Value of the whole business, debt included, ÷ operating profit before depreciation.
ev_ebitda.read: Lower is cheaper. Fairer than P/E when companies carry different amounts of debt.

pe.label: P/E
pe.what: Share price ÷ yearly profit per share.
pe.read: Lower means you pay less for each ₹1 of profit. Compare with peers and the company's own history; a low P/E can also mean slow growth is expected.

pb.label: P/B
pb.what: Share price ÷ net assets (book value) per share.
pb.read: Below 1× means the price is under book value. Most useful for asset-heavy businesses and banks.

ps.label: P/S
ps.read: Useful when profits are thin or volatile. Compare only within the same industry.

pfcf.label: P/FCF
pfcf.read: Shows how much you pay for the cash the business actually generates after capex.
